messages:
JordanL: Quick heads upwe're doing a small serving config push tonight to enable cache dedupe and roll model v2.0-quant into prod. Need a one-paragraph RN + explicit pin/runbook.
NinaP: I can draft the paragraph. When's the freeze for copy?
JordanL: Freeze 15:30 UTC. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m checks.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled deploy "serve-config-dedupe-v2" -> prod. Command: `/deploy serve-config-dedupe-v2 --env prod --canary 5% --steps 15m,25%,full`
RaviS: Ops note: this introduces v2.0-quant (smaller footprint). Auto-fallback path to v1.9.8-fp16 exists but requires a pinned rollout. We should include explicit pin commands in RN.
MayaT: Oncall ack. Add quick alert rules: p99 latency >600ms OR error spike >1% for 3 consecutive mins => evaluate rollback. Also add disk OOM metric check.
NinaP: Draft RN blurb (WIP):
"Internal release: serve-config-dedupe-v2 (prod) - enables cache de-duplication and upgrades model to v2.0-quant (pinned). Expected throughput improvement ~8-14% and memory reduction. Canary: 5% (15m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100%. Rollback triggers: sustained p99 >600ms, error rate >1% for 3m, or OOM alerts. Rollback command and manual pin included in runbook. Internal audience only - eng, support, product."
JordanL: Good. Short headline for the channel post: "serve-config-dedupe-v2: cache dedupe ON + model pinned v2.0-quant; canary 5%->25%->100%; rollback on p99>600ms or errors"
RaviS: Add ops snippets: `deploy-bot pin model prod v2.0-quant` and `deploy-bot rollback serve-config-dedupe-v2 --to-model v1.9.8-fp16`. Also include a manual redeploy step in case auto-fallback fails: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/serve-prod --namespace=prod` (infra only).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary initiated at 01:05 UTC (5% traffic). Metrics: https://internal.metrics/redwood/deploys/8965432100
MayaT: t+8m: small spike in errors to 0.6% at t+6m, p99 +120ms. Still below thresholds. Monitoring closely.
JordanL: If error rate breaches 1% for two samples (3m), we rollback. Otherwise continue. Keep #eng-oncall and product-signal in the loop.
NinaP: RN final draft will be posted to #eng-releases at 15:40 UTC with the runbook link and metrics dashboard. I'll tag product and support leads and remind CS to hold external messaging until confirmed stable.
RaviS: Confirmed smart-routing policy `quant-safe-fallback` is attached to this deploy so traffic can be routed to older nodes if needed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramp executed  canary moved to 25% at 01:25 UTC.
MayaT: Post-ramp summary: error rate 0.15%, p99 down ~9% vs baseline. No action.
JordanL: Morning checklist: update internal docs with RN entry, attach console screenshot of model pin timeline, and send a 09:00 UTC update to product/CS with final metrics and decision.
NinaP: Posting RN at 15:40 UTC now. Thanks everyone.
JordanL: Great job team  I'll archive the thread after the morning update.
